messages:
maria: FYI running leo-13b bring-up with fp8 on H100 + KV cache. outputs degrade after ~1.2k tokens, looks like a soft NaN in attention path.
aj: short summary of symptoms?
maria: generation quality drop -> repeated tokens, then runtime logs an "inf" in qk_matmul and runtime falls back to fp16. also saw OOM spikes on one canary node.
samir: tiling/stride mismatch can cause OOB writes into KV buffer; seen this produce NaNs before. which runtime tag?
maria: rwinf/runtime:release-2026-03-18 on atlas-prod-canary. reproduced on local H100 and partially on L40S (L40S shows clip/saturation instead of NaN).
kai: can you paste minimal repro? I'll run the same on L40S and a small stress grid.
maria: minimal repro attached below:

maria: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(model="leo-13b", precision="fp8", cache=True)
prefix = "\\n".join([f"line {i}" for i in range(300)])
resp = c.generate(prefix + "\\nuser: ping", max_new_tokens=1500, stream=False)
print(resp.text[:800])
```

jess: infra-bot reported 3x CUDA OOMs on atlas-canary-3 during the run :warning:
infra-bot: [alert] cuda:OOM spikes x3 in 00:05; nodes: atlas-canary-3
aj: OOM + NaN -> likely tiling factor expands workspace or writes past alloc. that "write idx 65536 > alloc 65536" pattern rings bell.
kai: hypothesis: handshake picked H100 fused tiling but fallback path or metric calculation used L40S heuristic, yielding a misaligned stride and off-by-one. I'll add an assert to detect >alloc writes during canary runs.
samir: on quantization side, AWQ seems more robust to long-tail activation swings vs GPTQ in our small bench; AWQ per-channel scaling reduces sudden saturation. still, kernel misalignment triggers both.
maria: raw log snippet:

maria: ```
[2026-03-20T10:12:32Z] qk_matmul: compute kernel fp8_tile_v2
[2026-03-20T10:12:32Z] qk_matmul: nan encountered, fallback to fp16
[2026-03-20T10:12:32Z] kv_cache: write idx 65536 > alloc 65536
```

aj: ok that's an off-by-one/tiling boundary. short-term mitigation: enable `precision.hybrid_kv_safe=true` for leo-13b fp8. keeps KV storage in fp16 for seqs >1024. cheap and reduces OOM/fallbacks.
jess: pausing fp8 rollout for leo-13b on us-west-2 now.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for model leo-13b (fp8) on region us-west-2, reason: kernel handshake instability. CID: ROLLOUT-7821
kai: i'll push the assert and a canary metric for fallback-rate by model+prefix-length tomorrow morning, then run lengths=[256,512,1024,2048] across H100/L40S.
maria: if the assert reproduces consistently we'll bisect kernel changes between commits 7a3f2c..b2f9ab. i'll collect perf artifacts and upload.
samir: i'll queue AWQ/GPTQ/INT8 comparator runs using the same long-prefix seeds once you have a kernel fix, want to validate there are no subtle quality deltas after fixes.
aj: follow-up: add a perf-suite regression that runs long-prefix + caching + mixed-precision handshake on both H100 and L40S. this combo should be gated.
maria: adding a small eval that checks for generation cliffs after fallback->fp16 (detect repeated tokens / perplexity jump).
platform-bot: tagging @platform-team to consider automatic rollback if model fallback_rate > 0.5% over 1h.
kai: noted. i'll also instrument tiling_factor calc and assert tile_end <= alloc_len. will run quick stress and post bisect link here.
maria: thanks everyone, will post artifacts and bisect link in this thread when ready :thumbsup:
